It enables you to create an Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA), share medical records with doctors, book hospital appointments through ABHA's 'Scan & Share' feature, and securely store your health records in a government-approved PHR app. Additionally, Eka Care offers the convenience of monitoring your heart rate without the need for a smartwatch, downloading Cowin certificates, checking your health through AI-powered Self Assessments, and effortlessly tracking essential body vitals, including Blood Pressure (BP) and Blood Sugar levels.

1. Ayushman Bharat Health Account (आभा)  
Join the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) to obtain your ABHA (Health ID) card with your unique ABHA address and number. ABHA serves as the gateway to your digital health journey, enabling you to share health data with doctors, labs, and insurance providers by linking it with ABHA. On the other side, you can effortlessly receive medical lab reports, prescriptions, and diagnoses in your Health Locker from healthcare providers like hospitals, clinics, etc. Additionally, you can book hospital appointments through ABHA's Scan & Share feature.

2. Heart rate monitor app
Eka Care's heart rate monitor, also known as a pulse rate monitor, allows for precise measurement of your heartbeat using just your smartphone camera. You no longer need a smartwatch or a separate handheld device to assess your heart health. Simply use the Eka Care heart rate monitor whenever it is convenient for you. Additionally, this monitor automatically saves your daily measurements and generates a detailed heart history for your reference. You can also set up reminders to measure your heart rate based on your preferences.

3. Medical Records & PHR
Eka Care stands as the epitome of advanced medical and health records, offering a Personal Health Records (PHR) app that excels in its capabilities. Maintaining comprehensive medical and health records is instrumental in monitoring your health history and facilitating early diagnosis of health issues. Eka Care distinguishes itself as the premier PHR app, providing a robust platform for storing prescriptions, health and medical reports, vaccine certificates, and more. Additionally, it enables the creation of individual health profiles for each family member, allowing seamless management of the medical and health records of all members within a single application. These meticulously maintained medical records or PHRs can be effortlessly shared with your healthcare professional with just a single click, ensuring efficient and accurate healthcare management.

4. Vitals Monitor
On Eka Care, you can monitor your vitals by simply uploading medical and health records. Just upload your records, and all vital information, such as blood pressure, diabetes and sugar levels, cholesterol levels, and more, will be automatically converted into a date-wise tracking format. We have capabilities where you can manually add your vital data and keep a log, which simplifies the process of monitoring your health. Additionally, you can manage your fitness data by syncing your devices like Google Fit, Fitbit, Garmin, and more.

5. Manage your Cowin Services
You can efficiently download your CoWIN vaccine certificate quickly using the Eka Care app in just 30 seconds by providing your mobile number. Once downloaded, your CoWIN vaccine certificate is securely stored in your Eka Care locker for 24x7 offline access.

Plan SaludAndo es un programa para pacientes que busca apoyarlos en el acceso a los medicamentos Sandoz participantes. A través de este apoyo, se facilita que los pacientes cumplan su meta de adherencia a lo largo del tratamiento según lo indicado por su médico. 
El apoyo consiste en acumular puntos por compras de medicamentos Sandoz enlistados como participantes y utilizar estos puntos como descuento en las siguientes compras de estos mismos productos. Además el plan ofrece contenido sobre bienestar, salud y calidad de vida; y cupones promocionales para los usuarios suscritos. 
SaludAndo se relaciona con sus suscriptores principalmente a través de esta app, por lo que es recomendable su uso para disfrutar de la experiencia completa como usuario del Plan.
La app permite al usuario registrarse como suscriptor del plan, visualizar y llevar control de los puntos acumulados por compras de los productos participantes en farmacias, recibir notificaciones, cupones y códigos promocionales, disfrutar de contenido informativo y/o educativo, visualizar su nivel como suscriptor del plan.
Usted podrá hacer uso del Plan SaludAndo en el momento que realice sus compras directamente en las farmacia participantes; solicitando allí la acumulación de sus puntos y al usarlos como descuento. Pero es a través de esta app, que podrá ver en tiempo real los movimientos de sus puntos y tener así el balance actualizado al alcance de sus manos.
